verdict.rationale: Metorial is driven programmatically. It offers official TypeScript, Python and Go SDKs, secret API keys created in the dashboard, and a published OpenAPI spec. A runtime probe confirmed the REST API is live and Bearer-key-gated, so it can run headlessly from scripts or services, and samples such as the GitHub code-review bot show unattended automation use. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation or examples, an official CLI for non-interactive runs, and independent hands-on reports of Metorial running in CI.
